name: 86 Chaos 17.0.23
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.23
releaseTitle: Request Off Cutoff and Blackout Policy
notes: Adds an owner/admin-only Request Off policy with a configurable cutoff measured in days before the planned schedule release.
Adds owner/admin-only blackout date ranges with optional reasons; normal employee Request Off submissions are blocked on those dates.

Monthly workspaces can set the normal release day in the previous month; weekly/biweekly/custom workspaces can set release lead days. These values calculate deadlines only and never auto-publish a schedule.
Schedule/team/settings permission alone cannot change the Request Off policy. Existing Request Off review permissions and unrelated application behavior are unchanged.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.23
summary: Owner/admin-controlled Request Off cutoff and blackout dates aligned to the schedule release cycle.
description: Adds a configurable Request Off deadline before the planned schedule release plus blackout date ranges, with policy configuration restricted to account owners and workspace administrators.
